subject: Architecture deep-dive: residency & routing across EU/US/APAC — scheduling
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Blake <thomas.blake@acme.co.uk>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Architecture deep-dive: residency & routing across EU/US/APAC — scheduling

Hi Thomas,

Thanks again for the time on last week's call. Per our notes, the next step that will unblock procurement and the regional team is a focused architecture deep-dive that covers:

- Tenant routing model (single-tenant vs multi-tenant topologies per region)
- Data residency options (EU, US, APAC) and encryption/KMS patterns
- Failover and cross-region fallback behavior for latency-sensitive endpoints
- Compliance evidence overview (SOC 2 scope, audit artifacts)

Proposed durations: 60–75 minutes. Suggested slots (all in your local time):
- Wed Apr 19 | 09:00–10:15 BST
- Thu Apr 20 | 14:00–15:15 BST

Agenda draft attached (MR-Agenda-v1.pdf). Please let me know which slot works or propose two alternatives — we'll loop in our security/ops lead (Karthik) and Solution Architect (Laura).

If helpful, we can also run a short pre-call checklist to capture your compliance questions so Karthik can prep specific artifacts.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

Attachment: MR-Agenda-v1.pdf (1 page)
From: Thomas Blake <thomas.blake@acme.co.uk>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 17:30:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive: residency & routing across EU/US/APAC — scheduling

Marcus — thanks for the clear agenda. We definitely want Karthik on the call; SOC 2 scope and the routing behavior are the two things that will determine whether we go with a dedicated or shared deployment.

The proposed Wednesday morning slot conflicts with our APAC stakeholders. Could we look at the following instead (BST):
- Tue Apr 25 | 08:30–09:45 (would cover APAC morning)
- Thu Apr 27 | 15:00–16:15

Also: please include a brief written summary of what artifacts you can provide post-call (SOC 2 package, network diagram, sample audit log retention policy). Our Security PM (Alicia) is copied.

Lastly, do you have a secure place to drop the documents? We prefer a shared folder with access control rather than email attachments.

Regards,
Thomas Blake
Principal Cloud Architect | Acme Enterprise
thomas.blake@acme.co.uk
